name: Color Film

pages.text: Load into the camera, expose frames and develop according to the stage shown by the roll tooltip.

pages.title: Exposing
pages.text: Craft through JEI and load into camera attachments. After taking photos, remove that same roll: frame data belongs to it.

pages.title: Developing
pages.text: Craft the exposed roll with Awkward Potion, then Thick Potion, then Mundane Potion. Each step uses the special developing recipe; the roll tooltip shows the current stage. The result is developed color film.

pages.title: Printing
pages.text: Place the developed film into a Lightroom, choose a frame and supply paper with the required dyes. Developed film is not yet a paper photograph.
